mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals supply chain disruptions that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth < -10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is rising and payroll employment is falling simultaneously, it signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling simultaneously but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI is rising by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals a high-inflation, restrictive monetary policy regime that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and Y/Y CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is accelerating and consumer spending is rising, as measured by the year-over-year changes in GDPC1 and RSAFS respectively, it signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 and RSAFS growth both accelerating but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.
